title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
blurb: Combines Mamba-2's decay gate with DeltaNet's error-correcting state update, giving a linear-time recurrent layer that both forgets and overwrites precisely.
intro: Linear attention keeps a matrix state that only accumulates. The delta rule turns it into a key-value memory that corrects the value stored under each key; a scalar decay gate lets the memory forget quickly. The steps go from linear attention through the gated recurrence to the chunkwise (WY/UT) form used for training; the capstone wraps the recurrence in the full layer with projections, short convolutions and a gated output norm.
